==[[唐故輔國大將軍右衛大將軍揚州都督褒忠壯公段公碑]]==
蓋聞經邦致治，必資輔相之士；折衝禦侮，實賴將帥之臣。是以尚父鷹揚，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>於<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕九字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>於<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>聲稱頌騰芳史冊，存與日月爭暉，沒與金石不朽。至於拔萃著美，搴旗馳譽，繼雲<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>驊騮<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>軌其唯忠壯公乎？

公諱<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>字誌元。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>郡<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>人也。若夫<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>宗隱嶙，崇基冠於眾邱；長河浩汗，洪源導於積石。是以庭堅作士，西周<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>伯陽之教，幹木作師，東海<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>經明之績。煥乎方策，豈不<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>歟？祖<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕七字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>州<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>字德元<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>俗政洽唯良。考偃師，散騎常侍益都縣開國公，贈洪州都督八州諸軍事諡信公勤邁<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>功<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>公<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>極之秀氣<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>孝<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>踐<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>基於忠烈<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>表瑰奇，器量宏遠。峨峨焉猶曾峰之跱嵩霍，滔滔焉若清流之登江漢，故能齠年立誌，冠歲<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>名。質性方直，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>於汲黯交結<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕九字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>隨大業<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>薄伐遼左，公占募從征，年始十四。夫兵戰凶危也。遼碣遐阻也。童牙而從兵戰，忘<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>而涉遼碣，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>識基於是矣！高祖道逾湯武，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>今上地兼魯衛，爰始澄庸。公附翼方舉，攀光旭旦，委質邁奔走之臣，就列逾蜀漢<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>頭朝散大夫從上破西河<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>遷銀青光祿大夫。昔舞陽策名，從沛邑而力戰；子衛效命，臨昆陽而先登。永<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>茂勳，方駕前烈。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>與<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>劉元靜破<small style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>千戶。又從上討薛舉、劉武周，以功授樂遊府驃騎將軍，進封武安郡公，食邑並前二千戶。

公勇冠三軍，氣高<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>戰。<small style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>王世充<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>第一<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>授<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>尋<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕七字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>上初踐少陽，無忘惟舊，除左虞候率。及膺寶命，言念嘉庸，拜左驍衛將軍。若乃盡<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>召於往<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>令孰能恩隆善賞，禮優夜拜者哉？俄賜別食，封四百戶，遷左驍衛大將軍，又為梁州<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>使雍岐<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>州<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>進封<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>公，食邑<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>千戶。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>食封<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>戶通前<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>百戶。又以<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>官檢校原州都督，又統承風道行軍討吐穀渾。丁父憂，未幾起復本任。文德皇后山陵檢校<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>於<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>府加等進秩，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>寵歲重於周行。而司勳授冊，天下所以勸善；良史執簡，後昆所以欽風。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>覽前書<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>惟近代<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>陵<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>大將軍。尋遷<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>衛大將軍<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>齊聲內典鉤陳，與辛趙而方軌，非聖帝不能疇茂績，非奇才不能取高位。於是見君臣之合契，唱和之如<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>焉。又丁母憂，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>本<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>錡懷蓼莪而疚心；泣血苫廬，瞻几筵而增絕。銜恤成疾，致毀遽漸。中使結轍於<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>問<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>奇於藥劑<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>心膂慈深覆育親<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>鑾<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>同既班<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>貴又詣所言公銘戴恩私，對揚忠到。城郢之誌，豈惟楚臣？慎赦之言，寧慚漢相！既而子輿日<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>平仲不<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>類彼劉<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>宗<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>以貞觀十六年<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>月十八日，薨於京師之醴泉裏第，春秋卌五。上情深悼傷，舉哀於別次。雖<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之痛<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>孫<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>君之悲仁祖，方之蔑<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕八字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>於念功勸善之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>實深於追往。故鎮軍大將軍、右衛大將軍、褒國公段誌元，器宇敦確，風略沉毅。委質運始，宣力<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>效勇<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>於麾<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>勤<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>方<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>曆永寄心膂，與善冥默，奄焉殞喪。震悼之情，倍深傷惜；哀榮之典，宜加恒數。可贈輔國大將軍使持節都督揚和<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>潤常<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>七州諸軍事<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>官<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>於昭陵<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>塋地並東園秘器。葬事所須，並宜官給。賻布絹五百段、米粟一千石。四品一人監護。其儀仗送至墓所，仍送<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>事上又追懷功烈，乃詔司存，圖形於戢武閣。太常考行，諡曰：「忠壯公」。禮也。

惟公氣岸崇峻，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>宇<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>深。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>樹幡旗<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>懷<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>猛誌<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>托貔貅而靡懼；高節邁俗，觸雷霆而不驚。逮乎河出馬圖，腰佩<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>紐，爵兼千乘。裂<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之膏腴，位<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>漢庭之榮寵，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之道克<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>於家國仁義之風，不愆於出內，懷公孫之不伐，慕考甫之循牆。行戒剛強，晦其扛鼎之力；言思木訥，韜其湧泉之慮。加以敦睦宗族，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>鄉黨<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>恕已以及物；仁心天發，輕財以濟貧。豈非朝廷之爪牙，人倫之領袖者已！故吏<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>名等慨徽音之遂往，懷遺愛而<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>請書<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕八字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>碑於<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕六字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>猶勒銘於江表。況乎誠著草昧，功參征伐。顧灌、絳而俯視，軼寇、賈而長驅。豈可使改名之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>有<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕六字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>為<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>頌曰：

方叔詠周，條侯稱漢。東都禦錄，昭伯翦亂。西晉握圖，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>治作翰。美矣人傑，於焉<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>奇節自然，瑰姿<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>發，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>方<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>日月。氣薄霄漢，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>高雲闕。王業肇建，帝道既融。策名若水，披荊漢中。腰靖難，提戟臨戎。斬良賈勇，括羽定功。鑄<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>職刑馬<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕六字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>入<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之榮超張<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>許。誌大心小，位隆德盛。奉國忘身，惴惴畢命。事親竭力，蒸蒸表行。蒞事以勤，臨下以敬。銜恤在疚，奪情<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>職。瘡<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>愈遲，毀<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕九字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>盡<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>藏舟難<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>奔羲易昃。冕興哀，縉紳掩淚。恩逾九列，禮亞三事。何以贈之？戎章<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>備，何以送之？鉦車按轡，勒銘貞石，義兼庸器。
==[[大唐故金紫光祿大夫彭陽憲公碑]]==
<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之所興分八<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>邱為<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>墨<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>所至<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>三者<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四十八字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>含<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>紀情以<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>繼<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>董之良筆綢石室之記，勒金簡之書。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>揚名<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>服<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>公諱德棻，字季<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>敦煌人也。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>肇開層<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>侯居<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>緒<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四十二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>蹈縹垂丹銘<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>曾<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>虯，魏龍驤將軍，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕九字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>開國子，<small style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>正卿上大夫、始豐二州刺史、彭陽縣開國公。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span 蓋聞在天成象，辰緯昭其度；在地成形，山嶽其寶。氤氳感會，孕育英靈。吐<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>神<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>周<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十六字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>耿賈<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>洪烈。爰披荊棘，遂偶會昌，望古為鄰，庶可揚榷。

公諱洛仁，字濟，博陵安喜人也。始自潁川<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十八字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>恩錫珪，顯於西京外戚。豈惟叔重博物，立言不朽；固亦子將清鑒，月旦稱工。年祀綿邈，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>慶清風獨開心鏡，即安樂土，權居晉陽。祖彪，齊儀同三司善元郡守武川鎮將、襲爵寧<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>縣公<small style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>公<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕六十字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>聽鳥觀<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>所<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕七十九字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>構惑忠正<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>賢<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>露<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>德<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>
==[[散騎常侍贈太常卿陽翟侯褚公碑]]==
府君諱亮，字希明，河南陽翟人也。元鳥<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>緒，白狼表慶。殷<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四十二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之功，貞臣佐非常之德，即府君十一代祖安東將軍揚州都督關內侯<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>道可師<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>用仁宏教，文武不墜，英風自遠。屬胡兵入洛，晉馬浮江，爰及宋齊，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十七字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>中齊東陽太守，復為侍中，遷吏部尚書，贈太常卿，諡貞子。門庭清簡，少懷雅<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>清譽<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>蒙梁儀同廬陵<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>東閤祭酒、太子中舍人東朝沃誥上邸披襟韜<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>政霞綺敷<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>動名教於搢紳，映徽猷於寮采。府君辰緯疑曜，川嶽降靈，黃<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>帝師之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>允<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>焉浩浩焉。神情共雲巘爭高，令聞與風鬆俱遠，汰鉛華於筆海，架將匠於天材。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十九字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>丁秘監府君憂，哀號致毀，幾將滅性。陳後主棲神雅什，纂曆鴻圖。景曖春坊雲<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>子<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>命<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>屬，允膺嘉選。隋開皇九載平陳，府君南朝冠冕，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>京謁見家國<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>不求聞達。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>庭。大業七年，授太常博士。彝倫為施政之本，忠信乃達禮之源，凡厥<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>益多<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>修<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>以為黃門侍郎，雖霜威見屈，而風概彌竦。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>自天縱聖，神武遐<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>入幕之賓。武德元年延為文學。太公之逢西伯，高步天師；鄧禹之赴蕭王，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十八字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>輸山川形勝，乃托賞風雲。恩眄賜詩，有同枚叔；上書諫獵，尤切馬卿。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十九字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>太宗監國，光啟震維，必俟正人，務從國本，改授中允。貞觀元年封陽翟縣男，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>食邑七百戶。及年登月制，休老於家。輜蓋成陰，桓春卿之寵錫；芳珍狎至，石大夫之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>寢疾而薨。太宗為之廢朝，悼深流涕，中使相望，存問不絕。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>魏<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>東園秘器。葬事所須，並宜官給，儀仗鼓吹，送至墓所。夫人柳氏，亦同安厝。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>慕無<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>老、莊之齊致，同李、郭之清塵，言行無爽於庭蘭，忠慎有逾於溫樹。洞握河之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>簡<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>策名侍近。時逢靜亂，早擅文房，預參帷幄，恭承嘉眄，乃留情於啟沃，谘<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>秋<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之際遠諧清放之前。所制文集，撰成廿卷，鹹為<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>詔侍奉述作陳<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>流詠<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>子<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>普州長史襲封陽翟侯遂賢，撫瞻霜露，永懷罔極，歲月綿遠，淒涼荒壟。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十七字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>式刊貞石，敢為銘曰：

鬱英遙源，增華胄緒。纂禖承業，昭鉤析宇。粵自恭公，祚流子褚。德<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十八字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>聲。珪璋逮襲，燮佐光才。家崇晉去，國喪陳來。語默雖切，榮名詎摧。一<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十八字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>名揚。青蓋象屯，金陵氣竭。利在攸往，誕生聰哲。二陸道存，三張譽折。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十九字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>府。門庭雅素，意緒薰華。賦樓光炤，文閣生霞。琴延夕月，酒泛晨花。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>壽<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>家<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十九字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>譽無虧。綜冠蓬<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>義標科籀。神理凝絢，清文挺秀。蔚鬱才林，超揚詞囿。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕八字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>
